blurb: Step into the vibrant world of Miami’s trendsetting arts district with this guided walking tour through Wynwood. Known globally for its striking street murals and creative spirit, Wynwood is also home to an exciting culinary scene that reflects Miami’s cultural crossroads. As you explore its colorful streets, you’ll savor a curated progression of international flavors—from the bold heritage of Peru and the spice-laden traditions of India, to the warm, shareable flavors of the Aegean and artisanal Italian-inspired desserts. Along the way, your guide will share stories that connect food, art, and community, leading you to the district’s iconic open-air museum of street art. More than a food tour, this is a sensory journey through one of Miami’s most dynamic neighborhoods.
